description: This file defines the metadata (vardefs) for the 'Contact' module in the SuiteCRM project. It specifies database table configuration, field definitions, indices, relationships, and other metadata related to the Contact entity used in the CRM system.
external_files: Relationships with other modules such as 'accounts', 'contacts', 'leads', 'notes', 'tasks', 'users', 'campaigns', 'emails', 'aos_quotes', 'aos_invoices', 'aos_contracts', etc.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: Class responsible for creating variable definitions (vardefs) for modules in SuiteCRM

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Static method to generate vardefs for a given module and object with specified options
